sector_etfs.mapping_methodology: Standard GICS sector classification for each of the 35 universe symbols, mapped to the corresponding SPDR Select Sector ETF that tracks that GICS sector (the conventional, widely-used sector-benchmark pairing -- e.g. XLK for Information Technology, XLY for Consumer Discretionary). This mapping is NOT sourced from any live feed or file already in this repo (none exists -- confirmed via grep for XLK/XLY/XLC/sector/GICS across the whole repo before writing this, zero hits) -- it reflects each company's well-established, long-standing public GICS sector membership. These are large, long-established companies whose sector classification is stable and not a judgment call this task invented; still, this mapping should be treated as a documented ASSUMPTION, not ground truth pulled from an authoritative source inside this repo, and re-verified against a live sector-classification feed before any production use.

XLF.note: PayPal Holdings is classified under GICS Financials (Financial Services industry group, Transaction & Payment Processing Services sub-industry), not Technology, despite being a payments/software company -- this is the standard, well-documented GICS classification, not an idiosyncratic choice.
